name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1' accurately describes the body: it reloads portrait set 1 then displays the current chapter's dialog page 1. The trailing _1 is the portrait-set index passed to fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1) (a domain-meaningful value; sibling handlers load sets 1/2/3/6/7), NOT a Ghidra address residue (entry addr 0x34be7 has no _1 relationship). Keep.
purpose: Shared portrait+dialog helper: reload portrait set 1, then show data_fd2_current_chapter_text dialog page 1 with the standard dialog geometry.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no-branch (cyclomatic 1). Calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1) then fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=1, 0xA0000 framebuffer, 0x140 stride, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) and returns. No RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used; the dialog call's return is discarded. The compiler-injected CALL __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue is elided in src (it consumes the 0x28 frame size each entry path pushes before reaching this body). In the original binary this body is reached by two adapter stubs (handler_05 via 'PUSH 0x28; JMP', handler_20 via 'PUSH 0x28; fall-through') and also hosts three Class-3 shared entry points (+0x0F 8-PUSH chain head, +0x28 text-push+CALL+RET dialog tail, +0x36 bare RET) borrowed by other handlers; those are reproduced inline in their respective consumers for Layer-2 equivalence.

returns.semantics: No return value. (Ghidra shows a residual undefined4* only because callee fd2_display_dialog_scene leaves its result in EAX; the function is void __cdecl and discards it; src signature is void.)

notes: Both name and comment kept; chevt1.c not modified (src comment lines 1392-1437 already accurate, precise, ASCII). Ghidra plate semantically consistent with src comment -> plate not touched. Verified body against disassembly (CALL __CHK @0x36cd7; fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1) @0x10b4e; PUSH chain 1/0x13/0x4A/0x4C/0xCD/0x140/0xA0000/page=1; PUSH [0x53a79]=data_fd2_current_chapter_text; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene @0x15f84; ADD ESP,0x24; RET). Callers: fd2_chapter_event_handler_05__ch13_thunk @0x34d68 (direct CALL) plus fall-through/JMP adapter handler_20 @0x34be2.
